Method of Attack: Embedded in apps like camera plugins, photo editors, image wallpaper apps, system and security utilities
Subscribes users to expensive premium services by loading websites and clicking links without user knowledge
Reads verification codes from text messages to confirm subscriptions
Steals phone contacts and delivers them to attackers
Attack Vector: Malicious apps on Google Play Store
Indicators of Compromise: Apps in categories: camera plugins, photo editors, image wallpaper apps, system and security utilities
